podcast.title: "Paradise by the Dashboard Light" Play-by-Play
podcast.body: Yankee Legend and former shortstop, Phil Rizzuto, who transitioned into a play-by-play announcer, contributed a distinctive baseball play-by-play narrative to Meat Loaf's song "Paradise by the Dashboard Light." His commentary adds a unique, dramatic element to the song's narrative. "Then we get Yankee Legend, shortstop turned play by play announcer Phil Rosuto, who gives us, well, the play by play."
